name: Chain Stitch
definition: The foundation loop. It creates linear structure, starting edges, spaces, rings, and lace gaps.

name: Slip Stitch
definition: A low-height connector stitch that joins, travels, or creates dense surface texture.

name: Single Crochet
definition: A short dense stitch with firm fabric and compact texture.

name: Half Double Crochet
definition: A medium-height stitch with a slightly ridged, flexible fabric.

name: Double Crochet
definition: A tall common stitch used for fast growth, lace, shells, and granny clusters.

name: Treble Crochet
definition: A very tall stitch that creates elongated posts and open fabric.

name: Increases And Decreases
definition: Shape operations that add or remove stitch count.

name: Front Loop Back Loop
definition: Loop-target variations that change ridge direction and fabric texture.

name: Post Stitches
definition: Stitches worked around the body of a previous stitch rather than into its top loop.

name: Shell Stitches
definition: Multiple tall stitches worked into the same stitch or space to create fan shapes.

name: Puff Popcorn Bobble
definition: Dimensional cluster stitches that create raised bumps and tactile texture.

name: Cluster Stitches
definition: Partially completed stitches joined at the top or base.

name: Picot
definition: Small looped point made from chains, often used as a decorative edge.

name: Filet Blocks
definition: Open and filled mesh blocks used to make images, letters, and lace diagrams.
